description: This file defines the GeneratorAdapterFactory class, which implements multiple interfaces to serve as a factory and adapter for a stream generator within the Orleans framework. It manages configuration, buffer pooling, receivers, and stream generator setup, facilitating generation and streaming of events without reading from storage.

classes.name: GeneratorAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory and adapter for stream generator streams, handling configuration, creating receivers, cache management, and integrating with Orleans stream infrastructure.

classes.name: GeneratorAdapterFactory.Receiver
classes.description: Inner class implementing IQueueAdapterReceiver, managing message retrieval and delivery using a configured stream generator.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and initialize a GeneratorAdapterFactory with dependency injection.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes internal structures like receivers and configuration.

methods.name: CreateBufferPoolIfNotCreatedYet
methods.description: Lazy initialization of a buffer pool used for stream data buffering.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Returns the current factory instance as IQueueAdapter.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache interface implemented by this factory.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns or creates the stream queue mapper.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Provides a handler for delivery failures, defaulting to a No-Op handler.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Stub for queuing message batches; in this implementation, it completes immediately.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a receiver for a specified queue, associating a stream generator.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Updates the generator configuration and applies it to all receivers.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a cache backed by the pool for a specific queue, with monitoring.

methods.name: LogInfoNoGeneratorConfigurationFound
methods.description: Logs information when no generator configuration is available.
